---
title: "German RSE Survey Books"
---

Each survey year focuses only on respondents working in Germany and is
presented independently using the questions and answer options contained in
that year's dataset. No cross-year harmonisation is applied.

## Survey years

- [2017 Germany survey](2017/)
- [2018 Germany survey](2018/)
- [2022 Germany survey](2022/)
- [2026 Germany survey](2026/)
- [2026 curated Nordic analysis](2026/insights/)

The 2016 export contains only United Kingdom respondents, so it is not included
in this Germany-focused publication. All published yearly books are generated
dynamically from the corresponding response and question-metadata files. The
country is configurable when generating a book, so the same process can produce
books for other countries represented in a given year.

The separate 2026 Nordic analysis preserves the curated narrative and
question-by-question analysis using its committed frozen results. Generic books
include submitted and partial records, and each question reports how many of
each provided an answer. The curated analysis remains submitted-only.
